scares.description: Car drives past the camera over the tracks with a sudden sound cue.
As girl drives car a flashback to the earlier disaster plays with sound.
Flashback of the previous head explosion death suddenly with a sound.
Eric is almost hit by a speeding van.
Darlene exclaims "I'm gonna stay alive as long as.." before a pole falls over and kills her.
After a black screen suddenly we get a sound cue and the woman comes back to life.
